title: Profiling News Media for Factuality and Bias Using LLMs and the Fact-Checking Methodology of Human Experts

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to determine a news outlet's stance on public figures, trending topics, and specific policy areas, and using these textual responses as evidence to predict the outlet's overall political leaning (e.g., Left, Center, Right) using both zero-shot classification and fine-tuned text classifiers, evaluated against Media Bias/Fact Check (MBFC) labels.

Evaluating the correlation between the model's prediction accuracy and the news outlet's popularity by plotting correct versus incorrect predictions against the outlet's Alexa Rank, revealing that the LLMs perform significantly better on well-known media.
Comparing the LLM's prediction accuracy for U.S.-based media outlets against non-U.S. media outlets to identify geographic disparities resulting from the model's training data.
